title: Happy People | Spring (part 1) [Happy People Documentary | Spring in Siberia Part 1
summary: The first part of Dmitry Vasyukov's four-part Russian documentary series about trappers and villagers living in the Siberian taiga. This episode follows spring life along the Yenisei, with hunting, fishing and subsistence in harsh surroundings.
why: Recommended as the authentic original that many prefer over Werner Herzog's shortened re-cut.

quote.text: I like the original much better, I think of it as the authentic view
